title: Systema Foundation: a new Alliance to strengthen the competitiveness of Italy’s productive system
body_markdown:
**Businesses, industry, finance and associations join forces for competitive supply chains in the transition**


Rome, 29 September 2026 – On the occasion of Open-es ACT 2026, the event dedicated to defining priorities and actions to strengthen the competitiveness of businesses and supply chains, Eni, Confindustria, Enel, Snam, UniCredit, Q8 Italia, Webuild, Accenture, Avvale and RINA announce the launch of Systema Foundation, established through the shared commitment of the Open-es Alliance partners to expand their ability to engage the key stakeholders of the national system.


Systema Foundation is a forum for guidance and dialogue, with the ambition of progressively bringing together the leading actors of the Italian system and enhancing the contribution of industry, finance, associations and institutions to define shared priorities, models and approaches that help supply chains address the risks and seize the opportunities arising from the ongoing social, environmental and technological transformations.


Its objective is to simplify the path for businesses by reducing complexity and duplication, and by jointly addressing what can be managed more effectively at a system level.


Open-es, which has already reached more than 48,000 companies, represents the first concrete expression of this approach to “Fare Sistema” and will remain at the heart of the journey promoted by Systema Foundation. Open-es will continue to engage businesses, support their development, and foster coordination across supply chains, leveraging the expertise and solutions made available by the Alliance partners.


*"Eni’s industrial development has always gone hand in hand with the growth of the countries, territories and supply chains in which it operates. The same spirit has guided the Open-es journey, making concrete solutions available to all businesses to help strengthen the productive system. The establishment of Systema Foundation marks a further evolution of this path: a governance model that is even more open and representative, aimed at progressively broadening the Alliance and bringing together the capabilities of the country’s leading stakeholders around the priorities that impact supply chain competitiveness,"* said Claudio Granata, Eni Director Stakeholder Relations & Services and President of Systema Foundation.


Systema Foundation is open to the participation of new organisations willing to contribute to the Alliance’s priorities, progressively expanding its representativeness and its ability to support the competitiveness of supply chains over time.
